create_tedlium_builder_config: create a TedliumReleaseConfig builder config for a specific TED-LIUM dataset release with download URL and split paths
build_tedlium_dataset_builder: build a BeamBasedBuilder for the TED-LIUM speech recognition dataset with audio and text features
generate_examples_from_stm: generate dataset examples from a TED-LIUM STM transcription file by parsing speaker, timing, and transcript fields
extract_audio_segment: extract an audio segment as a numpy array from a NIST sphere file given start and end times in seconds
parse_gender_label: parse a gender label string from an STM file label field returning female, male, or -1 for unknown
